event_name: MP0712 Phase 1/2a initial clinical data (within coming months; 2026)
indication: SCLC, lung LCNEC and extrapulmonary NEC
expected_disclosure: Initial early dose-escalation data from the first MP0712 cohorts. The study is designed to report safety/tolerability (AEs, SAEs and DLTs), 203Pb imaging/biodistribution and organ/tumor dosimetry, PK, and any evaluable preliminary RECIST activity. The company has not announced the exact conference, cutoff date, patient count, or which efficacy fields will be mature; comprehensive safety and efficacy data are expected in 2027.
uncertainties: The company only specifies 'within the next months' and has not named a venue.
The first readout may be dominated by safety and dosimetry; preliminary antitumor efficacy may be immature.
